origin.description: Geary's ratio of the mean absolute deviation to the root mean square.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: Drop missing values first. In Python the argument is na_rm.

origin.details: A normal sample is near sqrt(2/pi). A constant sample is NaN because both the numerator and the denominator are 0.
origin.value: One number for a vector, or one number per column.
